page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs, consisting of 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, and 16.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 33 MB L3 cache. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, does not include local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. It does not contain any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place this server consistently in the average performance tier for most standard compute and memory tasks. It achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1413.0 and a multi-core score of 5330.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 10387.28. In memory bandwidth testing, it recorded 423.68 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 56.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The server demonstrated average throughput for static web serving at 9.01 GB/sec and software compilation with Clang at 8016.0.

Tradeoffs are evident in memory-intensive and database workloads. Redis SET operations performed weakly, falling into the bottom 25% with 7.82 million operations per second. Additionally, while the server handles small-scale LLM inference adequately, performance drops significantly on larger models, with 7B model prompt processing rated as poor at 15.85 tokens/sec. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and lack of local storage, this instance is applicable for moderate compute tasks, static web serving, and basic software compilation, rather than high-throughput database operations or large-scale machine learning workloads.
